correctness.rationale: The proof identifies induced rook forests with path forests of K_{m,n}, establishes maximality via all degree-deficient endpoints in both directions, derives the balanced Hamilton-path case and the rectangular degree-two saturation case, and extracts the exact component coefficients from the labeled two-sort exponential formula. The finite direct-graph verifier agrees on 11 boards and an independent recurrence agrees on 1,375 parameter triples. All boundaries m=n and m<n, s ranges and factorial denominators are handled.

value.rationale: The motivating well-f-covered problem asks whether inclusion-maximal induced forests are of uniform size, and minimal feedback vertex sets ask for the associated extremal transversals. The result classifies every such forest in a canonical product family and gives a new labeled count by number of connected components, distinguishing a sharp rectangular component transition. This is a motivated exact distribution, not merely a known scalar feedback size or factorial-square special case.
